title: Replace repeated whole-prefix work with a monotonic incremental state machine

source.title: vLLM PR #40298 incremental MiniMax M2 streaming parser and review
source.claim_scope: The closed-unmerged source demonstrates an incremental parser decomposition and review-discovered invariants, not a target performance result or merge endorsement.

implementation_recipe: Write a transition table for request start, partial token or delimiter, complete field, item completion and request completion.
Carry a monotonic consumed cursor plus only the unresolved suffix required by the grammar.
Process each new delta once and advance externally visible indices exactly once at the owning transition.
Reuse the batch path's schema lookup and serialization rules so the incremental path cannot invent a second semantic contract.
validation_recipe: Compare the combined incremental output with the frozen batch or replay oracle at every single split point.
Add randomized chunk partitions, empty chunks, multiple items, delimiter fragments, trailing text and parser reuse.
Measure total work for increasing history length and fit linear versus quadratic growth rather than quoting one short-input latency.
Verify that retained state is bounded by unresolved grammar context rather than total history.
expected_bottleneck_shifts: Repeated whole-history scanning should become near-linear total work in emitted input length.
Delimiter recognition, allocation and output serialization can become dominant after old-prefix work is removed.
failure_modes: A transition clears unconsumed suffix data that belongs to the next field or normal-text state.
State is reset too early or survives across requests, changing names, indices or emitted arguments.
A delimiter split across chunks is emitted, skipped or recognized twice.
The incremental path concatenates values differently from the trusted complete-input parser.
The implementation keeps the complete history as its buffer, preserving quadratic slicing or search costs under a new class name.
scope_limits: Use only when successive calls reconsider a shared growing prefix and state can be owned for the same semantic stream.
Do not transfer concrete delimiters, field names or reset rules across parser protocols.
The source PR is closed-unmerged and therefore supplies discovery and review evidence only.

algorithmic_decomposition.baseline_dependency: Call k reprocesses all history 0..k even though call k-1 already established a valid parsed prefix.
algorithmic_decomposition.partition_axis: successive input deltas within one request-local stream
local_state: externally visible item index and emitted-prefix length
algorithmic_decomposition.combine_rule: Apply the transition function to prior state and only the new delta, retaining the shortest suffix that could still complete a split delimiter.
algorithmic_decomposition.finalization: Emit newly completed semantic fields, preserve trailing unconsumed input, and reset only at the explicit request boundary.
algorithmic_decomposition.work_complexity: Target O(total input plus emitted output) over the stream instead of O(number of deltas times accumulated history).
algorithmic_decomposition.span_complexity: Each call depends only on bounded parser state and its new delta, not a full replay of prior calls.
algorithmic_decomposition.communication_cost: Adds request-local state reads and writes while removing repeated reads of historical text or tokens.
invariants: concatenated incremental output equals the trusted complete-input semantic result
every input unit is consumed at most once except a bounded delimiter suffix
indices advance exactly once per item
state lifetime is exactly one request
anti_patterns: append to a full-history buffer and search it again
duplicate the batch parser's type and serialization rules
reset all state inside a per-item completion transition

candidate_archetypes.name: bounded-suffix incremental parser
candidate_archetypes.template: Track consumed position and grammar state, process only each new delta, and retain only the bounded suffix needed to resolve a split delimiter.

candidate_archetypes.name: cached prefix summary
candidate_archetypes.template: When a full parser state is unnecessary, cache the smallest sufficient summary of the accepted prefix and update it with each delta under an explicit stream epoch.
